title: Carlson's Masonic initiation and becoming master of his lodge

tellings.quote: I was raised in March of 1979, became master of my lodge in 1990.

plain: The researcher Randall Carlson tells Michels that he became a full Freemason, "raised" in the Masons' own word, in March 1979, and that he went on to become master, the elected head, of his lodge in 1990. He tells it about himself, as background for the older traditions and symbols he talks about on the show.
